## What's New

- Added a new high-resolution Lumina app icon designed for macOS.
- Added a complete Retina app-icon asset catalog covering 16 px through 1024 px.
- Updated the build pipeline to compile and embed the icon in release app bundles.

## Upgrade Notes

- This release bumps Lumina to version 0.2.1.
- Existing clipboard history, reminders, focus timer state, and media integrations are unchanged.
